$comment: Hand-written contract pin. NOT generated by `task proto` -- see packages/contracts/README.md.
embedding_dim_rationale: The graph is small -- four islands, on the order of 10-40 buses once M4's single-line diagrams are instantiated -- and the training set is 17,544 hourly steps per island. 64 keeps the GNN's parameter count well below the sample count while leaving M2's evidential head a wide enough input to separate aleatoric from epistemic variance. Changing it is a minor bump and a retrain, not a breaking change: node_embedding is a flattened repeated float and embedding_dim travels with it.
quality_layout: QualityMask.per_feature is parallel to feature_names; len(per_feature) == len(feature_names)

soc_fraction.note: Zero on non-storage nodes; read it with is_bess.

ghi_wh_m2_norm.note: Spatially degenerate: one distinct irradiance series covers all four islands (~111 km cell). Carries diurnal and cloud signal, no inter-island signal. See docs/data/nasa-power-resolution.md.

clearsky_index.note: The cloud signal with the deterministic solar geometry divided out. Same spatial degeneracy as ghi.

wind_10m_ms_norm.note: Two distinct series across four islands (~55x69 km cell).

wind_50m_ms_norm.note: Hub-height proxy. Paired with wind_10m it encodes shear.

pv_available_kw_norm.source: derived: ghi x node panel rating
pv_available_kw_norm.note: Zero on non-PV nodes; read it with is_pv.

pressure_kpa_norm.note: Kept for the cyclone signal -- a falling surface pressure is the classic precursor, and Ditwah is in the scenario library.

load_kw_norm.note: Downscaled from a monthly CEB ledger. The intra-day shape is constructed, not measured -- see the circularity warning in module1/data/load.py before training anything to predict it.

critical_load.note: Static. M3's load-shedding cost asymmetry keys on this.

notes: ASSET_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED has no column. A node with an unspecified type is all-zero across the six is_* columns, which is distinguishable from every valid type.

calibration_quality is what the offline artifacts can support today (ADR 0004). At runtime the simulator fills the electrical group and the mask is set per step -- the field is a floor, not a promise.

No feature in this vector is QUALITY_OBSERVED at node level except the temporal and static-topology groups. That is the honest state of the evidence and is the reason M2's epistemic head has something to do.
